# Zuri Command Agent API v1

## Authority boundary

This is the canonical contract between Zuri and the standalone `zuri-command-agent` runtime.
Zuri PostgreSQL is the durable authority for tenant identity, RBAC, command state, policy,
auditing, and LINE delivery. The Agent is a registered worker/consumer. It has no authority to
write tenant policy, call LINE directly, execute arbitrary SQL, or act on a different tenant.

| Concern | Authority | Agent permission |
|---|---|---|
| Zuri session, tenant, RBAC, group/OA binding | Zuri | none; receives scoped job only |
| Command/run/audit/outbox state | Zuri PostgreSQL | claim/update only through API |
| DuckDB analytical data | SmartGift Local Bridge | read only, registered query ids |
| Flex template admission and LINE Messaging API | Zuri | submit typed view model/evidence only |
| Product policy, budget, retention, kill switch | Zuri + GoVibe governance | read immutable snapshot only |

## Proposed API surface

All endpoints are candidate interfaces. They cannot be implemented until the FEAT36 Phase 2
atomic proposals and Phase 3 blueprint are accepted.

| Method | Path | Caller | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/agent-commands` | Zuri session / approved operator adapter | Create a preview or governed delivery request |
| `POST` | `/api/agent-commands/{commandId}/claim` | Registered Local Bridge | Claim one compatible queued job under a lease |
| `POST` | `/api/agent-commands/{commandId}/evidence` | Lease owner | Return an evidence packet for the registered query only |
| `POST` | `/api/agent-commands/{commandId}/release` | Lease owner | Release/retry a job with a safe failure code |
| `GET` | `/api/agent-commands/{commandId}` | Authorized owner/reviewer | Read redacted lifecycle and preview result |
| `POST` | `/api/agent-commands/{commandId}/approve-delivery` | Tenant Owner | Approve a review-required card for governed delivery |
| `POST` | `/api/agent-bridges/heartbeat` | Registered Local Bridge | Report capability/version/health without paths or secrets |

## Required envelope fields

Every command and bridge response carries `contractVersion`, `commandId`, `tenantId` (server
derived or server-issued only), `policySnapshotId`, `idempotencyKey`, `traceId`, and timestamps.
Evidence responses additionally carry `queryId`, `queryVersion`, `source`, `asOf`, sensitivity
classification, and a structured `CardViewModel`. Raw SQL, credentials, raw unbounded chat,
filesystem paths, and raw PII are prohibited fields.

## Compatibility and fail-closed rules

1. The agent refuses a job whose `contractVersion`, `tenantId`, policy snapshot, query version,
   lease, or expiry does not match its registration.
2. Zuri rejects evidence from a stale/foreign lease, a non-registered query, or a view model that
   fails the template/PII/CTA validator.
3. `preview` is never delivered to LINE. A `line_reply` or `line_push` intent sends automatically
   only when its resolved policy snapshot has `autoDeliveryAllowed` for that capability/template/
   recipient. Zuri then performs runtime admission, group binding and recipient revalidation,
   governed outbox, idempotency, and receipt recording. Otherwise the result remains review-only.
4. API compatibility uses semantic versioning. A breaking Zuri change increments major version
   and cannot be deployed while a registered bridge reports only an incompatible major version.

## Governance link

GoVibe may approve policy/query/template promotions and retain evidence, but it is not called in
the per-message hot path. Zuri consumes an approved immutable policy snapshot and fails closed
when no valid snapshot exists.
